description: This file defines the 'ImageGet' interface, which declares a method for retrieving images associated with a merchant store, based on store code and content type.

classes.name: ImageGet
classes.description: An interface for retrieving images related to a merchant store, specifying the method 'getImages' which returns a list of content files based on store code and content type.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of images for a specified merchant store, filtered by content type, potentially throwing a ServiceException.
